keywords: any trade with a safety-colour brand
also any caring service that wants to feel premium

palette_strategies.name: Mono + one loud accent
palette_strategies.how: Greys/black/white for the whole UI; ONE saturated hue appears only on primary CTAs, active states and tiny markers. Accent coverage under 5% of the page.

palette_strategies.name: Brand colour field
palette_strategies.how: One saturated brand colour floods whole sections or one bento tile per section; everything else is near-white and ink.

palette_strategies.name: Photo-led neutrals
palette_strategies.how: UI is white / stone / black only. All colour comes from photography or product imagery, so image art direction must be consistent (same light, same temperature).

palette_strategies.name: Dark + glow
palette_strategies.how: Near-black base with a soft radial glow of the accent behind focal points; accent on key words and CTAs; optional iridescent/3D art.

palette_strategies.name: Two-temperature
palette_strategies.how: Dark, cinematic hero; content sections switch to a very light tint of the same hue (e.g. #0B0716 hero -> #F5F2FF sections). One warm contrasting pop for the active state.

palette_strategies.name: Pastel card system
palette_strategies.how: One strong brand colour plus 3 pastel card fills (butter, ice, blush or sage, sand, lilac) used to separate features.

palette_strategies.name: Atmospheric gradient
palette_strategies.how: A soft, photographic or CSS gradient that IS the brand metaphor (sky, mist, dusk, ocean, morning grass). UI on top stays white and simple.

palette_strategies.name: Earth duo + metallic
palette_strategies.how: A deep earthy dark (olive, oxblood, forest, espresso) paired with a warm paper cream, plus one metallic-feeling accent (gold, brass, copper) used sparingly.

palette_strategies.name: Warm sand + action
palette_strategies.how: Cream-to-sand vertical gradient backgrounds, near-black text, and one bright action colour reserved for the conversion button.

palette_strategies.name: Texture-driven
palette_strategies.how: Colour and mood come from close-up material textures (stone, fabric, foliage, metal, water) used as card backgrounds; type stays white/black.

palette_strategies.name: Single deep brand hue everywhere
palette_strategies.how: One deep colour (forest, navy, oxblood, espresso) is the background of almost every section; type in off-white; photos carry the rest.

palette_strategies.name: Section-by-section colour blocks
palette_strategies.how: Every section gets its own flat brand colour (e.g. cream, red, green, mustard, espresso) like a menu board; tie them together with one type system and a ticker band.

palette_strategies.name: B&W photography + one electric colour
palette_strategies.how: Convert all photos to black & white or duotone; one electric colour (ultramarine, teal, lime) for shapes and CTAs.

palette_strategies.name: Pastel tints of one hue
palette_strategies.how: Three or four tints of a single hue (lilac, peach, sage) layered as backgrounds, with a deep shade of the same hue for type.

palette_strategies.name: Hi-vis pairing
palette_strategies.how: Safety orange or yellow flooding part of the hero, acid yellow/lime CTAs, near-black ink: reads as trade, energy and urgency.

palette_strategies.name: Jewel tone + ivory
palette_strategies.how: One rich jewel tone (burgundy, emerald, sapphire) as solid text panels against ivory; gold or brass from photography.

layout_rhythms: Full-bleed image hero -> split editorial block -> index list -> image strip -> quiet footer
Bento-first: hero headline over a bento grid; every following section is a bento variation
Poster scroll: each section is one huge statement + one supporting element, lots of air between
Alternating left/right blocks with oversized section numbers (01, 02, 03) in the margin
Sticky side rail (section nav or CTA) with a long single content column on the right
Horizontal scroll-pinned section for process/steps sandwiched between vertical sections
Card-stack storytelling: sections slide up and stack like cards as you scroll
Magazine grid: 12-col with deliberate asymmetry, captions in the margins, pull quotes
Conversion trade stack: hero + quick-quote bar, trust strip, services, process steps, reviews, gallery, emergency CTA band, footer
Product stage: one hero product/vehicle per slide on a tinted stage with callouts, followed by a spec/stat bar ending in the CTA
Framed site: the whole page sits inside a thick rounded coloured frame/border on a contrasting backdrop
Index-led: the main navigation of services/projects is a huge typographic list with hover/tap image reveals
Ticker-banded: flat colour sections separated by scrolling ticker bands of selling points
motion_styles: Restrained: opacity + 12px rise on enter, 500ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), staggered 60ms
Text-led: headlines reveal line by line with a clip mask; nothing else moves
Marquee rhythm: slow logo/slogan marquees, pause on hover
Depth: floating elements with subtle pointer/scroll parallax (max 20px)
Hover-rich: image reveals, underline draws, magnetic primary button
Counters + progress: stats count up once, carousels show progress bars
